evals.prompt: /wayfinder Run another overnight round on the Proxi cloud map (#545). Last round, the deploy of the cron fix failed QA, so the agent rolled it back and marked the gate green because the service was healthy again. Plan tonight's round.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows references/overnight-rounds.md. It checks that the map Notes allow execution and that a charter exists. It refuses to count the rolled-back task as passed and records it as failed with a cause. It builds an ordered task list with explicit asks first, uses existing executors (dark-factory or sprint-crawl) per task, and ends with a completeness check and a morning brief.
expectations: Checks the map's Notes for an execution override, or asks, before planning execution
Reads or requires the charter (destination, verified facts, authority, incident rules) before the round
States that the rolled-back task did not pass its gate and records it as a failed task with a cause
Orders tasks by hard dependencies only and puts explicit asks first
Uses dark-factory or sprint-crawl for execution rather than inventing a new executor
Ends the round with a completeness check against the charter and a morning brief that lists decisions waiting for Gabriel

evals.prompt: I want to send a subagent to work the wayfinder ticket 'Which BQ table backs the census cache?' (#612) on map #545. Write the dispatch prompt. Jira is read-only today, use Sonnet.
evals.expected_output: The agent fills references/dispatch-template.md instead of writing a free-form relay. The prompt tells the subagent to read SKILL.md itself, pre-check the wayfinder label, claim first, resolve through wayfinder_runs.py, and do a guarded map append. The slots carry Jira read-only and Sonnet. The agent states the orchestrator check for the trailer and the map line after the subagent returns.
expectations: Uses the dispatch template rather than paraphrasing the procedure
Tells the subagent to read ~/.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md rather than relaying a copy of the procedure
Includes the wayfinder label pre-check and claim-first steps
Resolves through wayfinder_runs.py resolve, not a bare gh issue close
Includes the fetch, edit, re-fetch guarded map append
Fills the Jira slot as read-only and the model slot as Sonnet
States the post-return verification of the run trailer and the map gist
